# Speedle

> Speedle is an open-source (UPL-1.0) authorization engine with the SPDL policy language. It consists of ADS (decisions) and PMS (policy management), SDKs in six languages, Speedle Cloud (hosted), and Speedle AI (authorization for and with AI agents, an MCP server, and the policy-modeler skill).

Speedle evaluates RBAC and ABAC policies for users, services and processes acting on behalf of users, so authorization logic stays out of application code. SPDL (Speedle Policy Definition Language) is the language for its policies and role policies. The full English documentation is in [llms-full.txt](https://engine.speedle.io/llms-full.txt); the canonical source is [teramoby/speedle-plus](https://github.com/teramoby/speedle-plus/) under the Universal Permissive License v1.0.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/): Install, configure and operate Speedle: concepts, policy management, deployment, APIs and SDKs.
- [Quick Start](https://engine.speedle.io/quick-start/): Install Speedle with go install or from source and make the first authorization decision with SPDL, spctl and the REST API.
- [About Speedle](https://engine.speedle.io/about/): What Speedle is, the project's origin, and the Universal Permissive License v1.0.
- [Overview](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/overview/): How Speedle maps to authorization terms: PAP, PDP, PEP, PIP, RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, XACML, identity, IAM and zero trust.
- [Architecture](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/architecture/): The PMS, the policy store, the ADS, SDKs and the request flow between them.
- [Integrations](https://engine.speedle.io/integrations/): REST and gRPC APIs, embedded Go, six client SDKs, and file, etcd, MySQL and MongoDB policy stores.
- [Playground](https://engine.speedle.io/playground/): Edit SPDL policies and test real authorization requests in the browser; the engine runs locally in WebAssembly.
- [llms-full.txt](https://engine.speedle.io/llms-full.txt): The full English documentation in one Markdown file, including the complete SPDL reference.

## SPDL and policy authoring

- [SPDL - Speedle Policy Definition Language](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/spdl/): The complete SPDL reference: policy and role-policy grammar, grant and deny, principals and AND groups, resources, conditions, attributes, built-in and custom functions.
- [Policy Management](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/pms/policy-mgmt/): Services, authorization policies and role policies, including resource-scoped role assignment.
- [Authorization Decisions](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/decisions/): Authorization requests, allowed/denied responses, reason codes, granted roles and granted permissions.
- [Custom Function](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/custom-function/): Extend condition expressions with application-specific functions served over REST.
- [Authorization Runtime/Decision API](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/api/decision_api/): The ADS decision API contract: IsAllowed, granted roles and permissions, discovery and diagnosis.
- [Policy Management API](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/api/management_api/): The PMS management API contract for services, policies, role policies and functions.

## SDKs

All six SDKs are version 0.2.0 and published, including npm `@speedle/sdk` (`npm install @speedle/sdk`).

- [SDKs](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/): Client libraries for the decision API in six languages.
- [Java SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/java/): Maven Central `io.speedle:speedle-sdk` 0.2.0, published.
- [Python SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/python/): PyPI `speedle` 0.2.0, published.
- [Go SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/go/): Go module `github.com/teramoby/speedle-sdk/go` v0.2.0, published.
- [C#/.NET SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/dotnet/): NuGet `Speedle.Sdk` 0.2.0, published.
- [Rust SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/rust/): crates.io `speedle` 0.2.0, published.
- [Node.js/TypeScript SDK](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/sdks/node/): npm `@speedle/sdk` 0.2.0, published. Install with `npm install @speedle/sdk`.

## Speedle Cloud

- [Speedle Cloud](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/cloud/): Hosted authorization for developers: sign-in and account management, SPDL policies, application tokens, the authorization API preview, limits, errors and downloads. Sign-in on cloud.speedle.io opens soon.
- [Getting started with Speedle Cloud](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/cloud/getting-started/): The console workflow: sign-in and account settings, a service, SPDL policies, session management requests, Playground tests and policy export.
- [Speedle Cloud application tokens](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/cloud/tokens/): Issue, protect, list, rotate and revoke service-scoped Bearer tokens, with one-time secret disclosure and recent authentication.
- [Speedle Cloud authorization API preview](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/cloud/authorization-api/): The published ADS IsAllowed request and response preview, with caller identity, a Node.js 22 example, policy snapshots and transport constraints.
- [Speedle Cloud limits and errors](https://engine.speedle.io/docs/cloud/limits-and-errors/): Account quotas, request limits, flat JSON errors, rate and quota headers, daily accounting and retry guidance.
- [cloud.speedle.io](https://cloud.speedle.io/): Speedle Cloud, a hosted authorization service. Free public beta; sign-in opens soon.

## Speedle AI

- [Speedle AI](https://ai.speedle.io/): Authorization for and with AI agents: use AI to manage access, and control what AI can access.
- [AI authorization patterns](https://ai.speedle.io/patterns/): SPDL patterns for data and training, model release, permission-aware RAG, delegated agents, MCP tool calls, agent-to-agent calls and zero standing privileges.
- [Speedle MCP](https://ai.speedle.io/#mcp): Speedle MCP launch preview: `@speedle/mcp` is published on npm as one package with check and manage modes. Install with `npm install @speedle/mcp`, or run the `speedle-mcp` binary with `npx @speedle/mcp check`.
- [Policy modeler skill](https://ai.speedle.io/#policy-modeler): The open-source policy-modeler Agent Skill turns employee handbooks and regulations into RBAC + ABAC SPDL models with tests.
- [Speedle MCP repository](https://github.com/teramoby/speedle-mcp/): Speedle MCP server source. `@speedle/mcp` is published on npm with check and manage modes. Run the `speedle-mcp` binary with `npx @speedle/mcp check`.
- [Policy modeler SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/teramoby/ai.speedle.io/main/skills/speedle-policy-modeler/SKILL.md): The entry point for the policy-modeler Agent Skill; its repository folder holds references, scripts, templates and English/Chinese example runs.
